title: finding(types,components): `HeaderBarSchema` declares eight keys the `header-bar` renderer never reads — `logo` is also mirrored as a wider `SchemaNode` arm (objectui#7759 residue)
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`. This is the residue that PR objectui#10300 (#10286, #7759 groups C/D) left by design: it retired `HeaderBarSchema.variant` and named the other unread keys in its Acceptance notes. ⛔ Not graded: `priority:*` and `type` belong to triage. The seat proposes `domain:spec`, because this is a contract ↔ renderer seam.

## Fact, re-read on `origin/main` `a05c3506`

| face | `logo` | the other unread keys |
|:--|:--|:--|
| TS declaration, `packages/types/src/navigation.ts` `HeaderBarSchema` | `logo?: string` ("Brand logo image URL") | `title`, `nav`, `left`, `center`, `right`, `sticky`, `height` |
| zod mirror, `packages/types/src/zod/navigation.zod.ts:66` | `z.union([SchemaNodeSchema, z.array(SchemaNodeSchema)])`, which is wider than and disjoint from the declaration's `string` | (not re-read) |
| read site, `packages/components/src/renderers/navigation/header-bar.tsx` | not read | not read. It reads `crumbs`, `search`, `actions` and `rightContent` only |

So:
- **`logo`** is declared-but-unread on both faces, and the two faces disagree on its type. It still holds a `WiderThanDeclared` row in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`.
- **The other seven keys** are declared-but-unread according to a source reading of the renderer only.
- An author who writes any of the eight gets a silent no-op, which is class c.

## Direction

`HeaderBarSchema` is objectui-own, so #7759 ruling 5617465269 rule 2 applies: the read site is the truth. ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove: a key with no read site retires (ruling D1-(ii): both faces dead and the spec silent ⇒ retire). **The measurement that decides each key:** does any in-tree author (`apps/`, `examples/`, `content/`, `packages/app-shell`, the designer `inputs`) write it?
- If no author writes the key, retire it from both faces with a tombstone.
- If some author writes it, the choice between enforcing (implementing the read) and retiring it is not mechanical. The dev reports it and the PM decides.

Seam: `types:navigation.ts#HeaderBarSchema` → `renderer:packages/components header-bar`
Dedupe words: `HeaderBarSchema logo unread` · `header-bar title nav sticky height unread` · `7759 residue header-bar`
